title: Microsoft 365 admin center: user requests for blocked Microsoft-built Frontier agents
summary: The briefing passes: the request workflow, admin paths, roles and licensing qualifications are supported by Microsoft documentation. The roadmap facts match, and the page distinguishes the documented Microsoft-built agent workflow from the Frontier-specific details that remain unstated.

claims.claim: The roadmap says users can request Microsoft-built Frontier agents blocked by organisational policies.
claims.quote: Agents built by Microsoft and available in the Frontier program will be displayed in the Agent Store. This feature will support users to request these agents if blocked by organizational policies.

claims.claim: The roadmap says administrators can approve or reject these requests through the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: For Admins, agents in the Frontier program can be managed through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. [...] Admins will have the opportunity to further approve and reject these user request.
